notes.title: Announcing Ancient Frontier: Steel Shadows
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11544693/c33a64567b5b015eba9b855192f8a6f18d6d3ac9.jpg[/img]

[b]Fair Weather Studios[/b] is proud to announce [b]Ancient Frontier: Steel Shadows.[/b]

Continue the epic saga of Ancient Frontier in an all new campaign.  Steel Shadows is a standalone RPG set in the epic universe of Ancient Frontier.  Take command of a rag tag band of pirates and outlaws as you fight your way across the Frontier for treasure and glory.  Delve into our latest turn based tactical RPG.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11544693/0c3890d2e2aa9549a052ef031baf0b969ef9f51b.png[/img]

With over 20 new story missions, new ships to command and new missions there will be plenty for commanders to sink their teeth into.  Steel shadows is set to be released in 2018.

Check it out right now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/734730/Ancient_Frontier_Steel_Shadows

[b]Will you survive the frontier?[/b]

notes.title: Bladestar - Version 1.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11544693/7d79ca5aedf26e814bc0d33a742a85975d441e8a.png[/img]

Greetings Pilots!

Today we have a patch for Bladestar that adds additional Steam functionality.  Most importantly we now support Steam Achievements.  While the game has always had its own Achievement system that earns you XP to unlock Upgrades, many of you had expressed interest in these being official Steam Achievements as well.  Now they have been integrated with Steam.

The changes include:

[list][*] Added Steam Achievement support for the already existing in-game Achievements.
[*]  Steam Leaderboard added.
[*]  Added in-game link to the Steam Leaderboards from the "Extras" Menu.
[*]  Moved "Upgrades" to the Main Menu so that it was easier for players to find where to spend their XP.
[*]  Reduced the Bloom on World 3 to increase visibility.
[*]  Several very minor balance tweaks.
[/list]

This should now be the final version of the game.  We hope you enjoy the changes.


Thank you for playing our games!

notes.title: Leaderboards are Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11544693/8a169611233b0d681cceb0663328966a0e553f9a.png[/img]

Greetings Pilots!

The game has always tracked your own personal high score.  But how do you rank against other players?  Well now you can finally find out.

To celebrate the new year Bladestar now supports Steam Leaderboards.  Now you can finally rate your highscore against everyone that has played since the leaderboard went live to start the new year of 2018.

You can also now link to the leaderboard from within the game.  This is found under the "Extras" option on the main menu.

Check out the leaderboard here:
http://steamcommunity.com/stats/424760/leaderboards/2390921/


Thank you for playing our games!

notes.title: Ancient Frontier Official Launch Date Announced - September 21, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26176768/b704695230b8351156d415365b6d3c3f63d32abf.jpg[/img]

We're very excited to announce that after two years of development our second title [b]Ancient Frontier[/b] will launch on [b]September 21, 2017[/b].

http://store.steampowered.com/app/521790

We would also like to take this opportunity to sincerely thank our fantastic community for all feedback, suggestions and ideas, because you helped to shape this game. 

This will be the second game launched by our small studio.  We have learned a lot since the release of Bladestar, and we hope both new and returning fans will be pleased with our first turn based strategy rpg.

Will you defend the frontier (on September 21st)?

notes.title: Ancient Frontier Kickstarter is now Live!
notes.content:
Greetings Pilots, 

We would like to thank each and every one of you for your support to date.  And thanks to players like you we have good news!  Our second game in this universe is coming to Steam.

Now, the same team that brought you Bladestar invites you to lend your support once again for Ancient Frontier.  The new game takes place in the same universe, but is a deep turn based strategy game.  Wage war with fleets of fighters and capital ships on the distant reaches of space. 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/81834518/ancient-frontier

The game will be something special with the backing of our amazing and generous community. Please lend your aid and back Ancient Frontier on Kickstarter today. 

Thank you, 
Fair Weather Studios
